pages.text: $(bold)Vein Mining$(): hold $(bold)Caps Lock$() while breaking an ore to mine the whole vein.$(br2)YUNG's Better Mineshafts and Cave Biomes make caves worth exploring. $(bold)Galosphere$() adds crystal caves with Silver (Sterling armour) and new mobs. $(bold)Goblin Traders$() live underground and trade things no villager will.
Do not mine for diamonds for long. $(bold)Bosses drop them$(): about 5 diamonds per 1,000 HP of boss. See $(l:overworld/minibosses)First minibosses$(/l).
